title: Falling Star (errata)
old_text: Do this twice: Deal 3 to a unit. (You can choose different units.)
new_text: Deal 3 to a unit. Deal 3 to a unit. (You can choose different units.)
explanation: No longer reflexive triggers. Pick all targets up front, opponent reacts once, then all damage resolves.
